description.value:
Duration constant

Your Marked quarry can never be hidden or undetected from you or your Feral Bond by ordinary means; it is at best concealed. Magical, technological, or supernatural concealment still functions against you normally.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Mark itself is now built (waywarden.mark-quarry.json grants TokenMark slug 'quarry'; target:mark:quarry is live). This card's own blocker is unrelated to that and remains open: it needs a conditional Immunity scoped to one specific target (your Marked quarry) *and* only to mundane detection-denial, not magical/technological/supernatural — Immunity is only proposable when blanket/unconditional, and a target-scoped, means-scoped partial immunity has no matching predicate mechanism anywhere in pf2e-source. This is a mechanism gap, not a missing number -- owner will decide how (or whether) to encode it.
